stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $79 \times 291$ is divided by $7$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $79 \equiv 2$ and $291 \equiv 4 \pmod{7}$. So the product is $\equiv 2 \times 4 = 8 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
